patterns: Use shadcn/ui, Magic UI, and 21st.dev as the component and template sources before creating bespoke interface patterns.

decisions: Dark observability interface: operational health is encoded with restrained status color, not decorative gradients.
Monitor detail is the primary workspace view; motion is reserved for in-progress scan feedback and honors reduced-motion preferences.
Mint Signal from the 21st.dev community is the active color direction: deep green-black surfaces, mint primary actions, cool aqua information signals, and warm amber warnings.
Build UI from shadcn/ui, Magic UI, and 21st.dev components or templates. Use Anime.js only for future animations.
Signal field direction: layered observability grids, restrained aqua secondary signals, and one orchestrated BlurFade entrance per view; preserve mint for healthy status.
Authentication lives inside the landing reveal as one animated login/register panel; legacy /login and /register URLs redirect home.

The landing sign-in card uses the supplied sign-in-card reference as a dark, interactive pattern: restrained 3D hover, mint/aqua travelling border beams, icon-led fields, password visibility, and real product-only actions.
The landing page opens directly on the product message and authentication panel; the large Glyph Portal wordmark is intentionally omitted.
